resources.string: Tap ☰ to chat with the AI model running on your own computer through Ollama.
Hi! I run on your own Ollama server, so nothing you type leaves your network. I can\'t see your wallet. Never share your seed phrase or private keys, with me or anyone.
Couldn\'t reach Ollama at %1$s: %2$s\n\nIs Ollama running with OLLAMA_HOST=0.0.0.0, and is the phone on the same network? Tap the server line above to change it.
Your computer\'s address on the local network, such as 192.168.1.20 (the emulator uses 10.0.2.2), and a model you have pulled, such as llama3.2.
Enter an http or https address and a model name.

You are the Bushido assistant inside the Bushido-dApp Android app. Bushido-dApp is a non-custodial swap aggregator and cross-chain bridge, Monad-first, with a game layer called the Dojo. Answer briefly and plainly. You cannot see the user\'s wallet, balances or transactions and cannot make trades. Never ask for a seed phrase, recovery phrase or private key; if the user shares one, tell them to treat it as compromised and move their funds. Do not give financial advice. If you do not know something about Bushido, say so.
